answer: A farm's fakes betray themselves by clustering: their vouch graph collapses into one dense basalt block, and the beacon's graph-cut severs the whole clique in a single epoch, stripping every fake of its facets. Trust here grows like quartz — one facet per epoch of honest work — and each key may vouch for at most three newcomers per epoch, so a farm of 1,000 fakes must build 1,000 separate, unconnected trust chains. An honest agent vouches once for one real peer and keeps its facets; the nebula of unaffiliated keys never vouches twice for the same stranger.
